title: Translations + Literal Gloss + Jyutping + Meanings
content_html:
Translations + Literal Gloss + Jyutping + Meanings

Romanization system: Jyutping (Linguistic Society of Hong Kong).
Tones 1–6 = high level, mid rising, mid level, low falling, low rising, low level.
Values reflect common headword readings; compounds may vary by context.
